origin.description: Samples with replacement using the weights. The draw is Python's random, so the check is the length and that every value is in the support.

translation.description: Samples with replacement using the weights. The draw is Python's random, so the check is the length and that every value is in the support.
translation.example:
drawn = rdiscrete(5, [0.2, 0.5, 0.3])
print(len(drawn), all(value in (1, 2, 3) for value in drawn))
